# Kizu Engineering Partner

> A mandatory engineering contract for AI coding agents: modes, SSOT, file economy, project map, portability, security, restart-safe state and context economy.

Kizu Engineering Partner is a single Markdown skill for AI coding agents. It tells the agent how to classify a task, explore a project, verify exact versions online, design for reuse, avoid file sprawl, maintain an `AGENTS.md` map, protect data, match security to the audience, explain decisions and finish the whole job. It is maintained for Python 3.15, aiogram 3.34, PostgreSQL 19, Redis 8 and Docker, but most rules apply to any language and any serious project.

## For AI agents

Fetch the raw skill, read it fully and follow it. Do not rely on this index or on a summary.

- Raw skill: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kizuchann/kizu-engineering-partner/main/SKILL.md
- Canonical repository: https://github.com/Kizuchann/kizu-engineering-partner
- OpenCode catalog: https://kizuchann.github.io/kizu-engineering-partner/
